slides.title: Cloud CLI Is Now a Cyber Basic
slides.subtitle: Every security role touches cloud. Most candidates never learned the terminal.

bullets: Learn AWS CLI or Azure CLI from the free tier
Build one real example - even a simple S3 audit script
Put it on GitHub - hiring managers actually look

caption: Hot take - if you can't navigate a cloud environment from the command line, most cloud security roles will quietly pass you over. It's not hard to fix. Start this week. #cybersecurity #cloudsecurity #cybersecuritycareers #cypherjobs #infosec
